    Call for Papers

    NEUREASON'26 invites submissions of 2-4 content pages for short paper or 25-35 content pages for full paper.

    Remark

    Paper submission is not mandatory for the participation of the workshop. Accepted short or long papers can be presented as posters during the workshop.

    Scope and topics

    All papers on topics of neural reasoning, scientific or mathematical discovery, both theory and application, are welcome.

    Submission instructions

    Papers should be formatted according to the the guidelines World-Scientific publication and submitted online through Openreview .

    Long papers should provide the necessary background knowledge to ensure they are accessible to first-year university students.

    Important dates

    All deadlines are at 23:59 UTC-12:00 ("anywhere on Earth").

    Submission deadline February 20th, 2026
    Notification of acceptance March 8th, 2026
    Workshop March 23-24, 2026
    Camera-ready submission April 26th, 2026

    Publication

    Selected long papers will be published as a book chapter published by World-Scientific in the mid of 2026.
